_: CHECKOUT CONFIG. Read by net/lib/pay.js; the store takes payments when PAYMENTS=chain and this file has a treasury. Every address here is a RECEIVE address: no key for any of them is on this server, and the server never signs anything. PAY_TREASURY=0x.. overrides the treasury on every chain without editing this file.
_treasury: 0x02b321E3B31e4Ca53cee164BEedc314f7345F6d4 is Duane's main wallet, which is where takings land until he names a dedicated one. Change it here or with PAY_TREASURY and restart; quotes already issued keep the old address, which is why a change needs a restart rather than a hot edit.

1.name: Ethereum
1._: Mainnet ERC20. Both token contracts were read on chain 17 Oct with symbol(), name() and decimals() before being added, never from memory: USDC quotes "USD Coin" 6dp, USDT quotes "Tether USD" 6dp. USDT returns no bool from transfer, which the verifier already tolerates.

56.name: BNB Chain
56._: BUSD only. The contract was read on 16 Oct with symbol(), name() and decimals() before being added, never from memory. Paxos stopped minting BUSD, but it is not dead: 283,188,732 still circulate and it quotes at 1.0001, so the store takes it. The Binance-pegged SOL BEP-20 was removed 17 Oct: real SOL is taken on Solana itself, not as a wrapper here.

WOLV.name: Wolverinu
WOLV._: Priced off its own Uniswap v4 pool, so no listing and no API key. The two words below are precomputed because they need keccak twice and never change for a given token: poolId = keccak(abi.encode(0x0, token, fee 0, tickSpacing 200, hook 0xe5e7...e044)) = 0x8fe46999c5956f2651471983e6eb648fe71ca4e5c9a6a66ef23c4132bcb8481e; slot0 = keccak(abi.encode(poolId, uint256(6))). Regenerate for another Pons token with dev/poolslot.py.

solana.name: Solana
solana._treasury: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Solana needs its own receive address: a base58 account Duane controls, NOT an 0x one and NOT the RAKE bot wallet in wallet/solana-wake.json, which has a secret key on disk and is traded by the WAKE loop. Until this is set the server offers no Solana currency at all, which is the safe failure: a wrong address here sends a player's money somewhere nobody can reach. PAY_TREASURY_SOL=... overrides it without editing this file.
solana._: Every mint below was read off Jupiter's token API on 16 Oct, not from memory, because the symbol alone is worthless on Solana: the search for USDT also returns a token called 'Up Side Down Tesla' with the symbol USDT, and USDS returns one called 'U.S DOGE'. The server matches the MINT and refuses anything else, the same rule the EVM side applies to contract addresses.
